AlterOp.doc: The four ALTER TABLE operations admitted by SQLite. RENAME TO renames the entire table; RENAME COLUMN renames one column. ADD COLUMN appends a new column with full ColumnDef syntax (constraints admitted). DROP COLUMN removes a column by name.

RenameColumn.doc: `RENAME [COLUMN] <old> TO <new>`. Both forms (with and without the COLUMN keyword) admitted.

AddColumn.doc: `ADD [COLUMN] <col_def>`. Reuses the ColumnDef type from create-table-stmt.

AlterTableStmt.doc: Parsed ALTER TABLE statement. Schema-qualified names deferred.

AlterTableParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the AlterTableStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token.

parse_alter_table.doc: Parse an `ALTER TABLE` statement. Token at `start` must be `KwAlter`. Delegates to create-table-stmt's column-def sub-parser for the ADD COLUMN form (re-exposed via a private helper that this leaf imports from the same file via crate-internal path).
